relevance.rationale: Derives generalized quantum Gel'fand invariants (higher quantum power-sum Casimirs) and polynomial characteristic identities on braid-group representations.

keyResults.statement: Constructs quantum power-sum Casimirs and explicit polynomial characteristic identities of L-operators and R-matrix braid generators.
keyResults.useForFolio: Underlies the higher power-sum trace tau_D(W^k) and full-twist pairing tau_D(Delta_3^2 W) analysis on the 2-component lepton braid words in QOU/StandardModel/LeptonFramedGNSAndStrainOrder.lean.
